blocks.text: Frank Meo Projections will host Art Streiber, who will present his work on November 18th during a screening event!
Art will share photographs and insights from his illustrious career as a world-renowned LA-based celebrity photographer.
His work has appeared on the pages of Vanity Fair, Wired, Variety, Empire, New York and New York Times Magazine.

His entertainment clients include ABC, CBS, NBC, HBO, CNN, MSNBC, Fox, TBS, MTV, Showtime, Netflix, Apple, Amazon, Universal Studios, Dreamworks, Paramount, Sony and Warner Bros. Studios. This promises to be a wonderfully insightful night of photography.
We present at 7:00 EST via Zoom: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/6692503751
We thank our sponsors for their continued support, Pro Photo Daily, Epson, PhotoShelter and American Photography.
All presentations can be seen on our YouTube channel, when visiting please subscribe: https://youtube.com/@PROJECTIONSNYC
